item.title: Motorcyclist Killed In Escambia County Crash
item.description: An Alabama motorcyclist was killed in a crash on Wednesday night in Escambia County. The Florida Highway Patrol said the 30-year-old Mobile man was traveling southbound on W Street near the intersection with Beverly Parkway. Troopers said he lost control of his motorcycle and fell onto the roadway. File photo.
